name: EDCI 5043
title: Exceptionalities in Music Education
description: Focus on achieving meaningful inclusion of students with disabilities. Discussion-based format utilizes curricular designs including Universal Design for Learning. Common types of disabilities are covered. This course does not meet a requirement for Special Education or provisional teaching certifications.
requirement_description: Open to students in the M.A. in Curriculum and Instruction, Music Education concentration, or with instructor approval. Not open to IBM students in music education; does not meet requirement for Special Education or IBM provisional certifications.
